new.note: Beef simmered in a sweet tomato sauce, piled on soft buns, eaten in magnetic boots.
new.how: Brown the mince with the onion and capsicum. Stir in the tomato sauce, sugar, Worcestershire and mustard and simmer until thick. Season. Toast the buns lightly and pile the beef in.

r2.make_ahead: Make the filling up to 2 days ahead

steps.text: Brown the mince with the onion and capsicum.
Stir in the tomato sauce, sugar, Worcestershire and mustard and simmer until thick. Season.
Toast the buns lightly and pile the beef in.

new.veg: Swap the mince for brown lentils.

new.n: Ice Box Salisbury steak with fries
new.note: Beef patties in brown onion gravy on the tray, fries on the side.
new.how: Cut the potatoes into chips, toss in the oil and salt. Roast the chips at 220C, turning once, until crisp. Mix the mince, breadcrumbs, egg and salt and shape into 4 oval patties. Brown the patties and set aside. Fry the onions in the same pan until brown, then stir in the flour. Whisk in the stock, return the patties and simmer until cooked through.

r2.make_ahead: Shape the patties a day ahead and keep chilled

steps.text: Cut the potatoes into chips, toss in the oil and salt.
Roast the chips at 220C, turning once, until crisp.
Mix the mince, breadcrumbs, egg and salt and shape into 4 oval patties.
Brown the patties and set aside.
Fry the onions in the same pan until brown, then stir in the flour.
Whisk in the stock, return the patties and simmer until cooked through.

new.veg: Use plant-based mince patties and vegetable stock.

new.note: Black tea brewed strong in the urn, sugared and poured over ice in tin cups.
new.how: Brew the tea bags in the boiling water, then lift them out and stir in the sugar. Cool, then chill. Pour over ice with a slice of lemon.
